commands.description: Describe a service type's advanced-config fields: per field a title, short and long description, suggested default, category, whether it's advanced, whether changing it needs a restart, plus the render schema (input type, options, bounds). Use this to understand which advanced configs exist and how to set them before calling set-advanced-configs, set-router-config, set-lmcache-engine-config, set-lmcache-server-config, or building a config set. Currently postgresql, vllm, vllm-router (the KV-aware router knobs), lmcache-engine (in-pod LMCache engine), and lmcache-server (standalone LMCache server).

fields.name: type
fields.description: Service type: postgresql, vllm, vllm-router, lmcache-engine, or lmcache-server

commands.description: Add a new vLLM instance

fields.name: name
fields.description: Instance name

fields.name: model
fields.description: HuggingFace model name (e.g., meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B)

fields.name: servedModelName
fields.description: Optional API-facing alias clients send as "model". When set, vLLM serves ONLY under this name (single token, no whitespace); omit to serve under the model path.

fields.name: resourceRequirementClassId
fields.description: Resource class

fields.name: replicas
fields.description: Replica count. Overrides the seed baked into the resource class. Set to 2 or more to activate the KV-aware vLLM router. (foreman #37)

fields.name: version
fields.description: vLLM version

fields.name: image
fields.description: Custom container image, replacing the published image for --version (e.g. a source-patched or locally-built engine). Must pin a tag or digest. An image on a Harbor belonging to this account is authenticated automatically; any other private registry is not supported yet, so the image must be public. Cannot be combined with --omni.

fields.name: routerImage
fields.description: Custom container image for the KV-aware router, which fronts the service at replicas > 1 (e.g. a patched router). Must pin a tag or digest. An image on a Harbor belonging to this account is authenticated automatically; any other private registry must be public.

fields.name: lmcacheServerImage
fields.description: Custom container image for the LMCache standalone server, which runs in remote cache mode. Must pin a tag or digest. Set --lmcacheServerGeneration beside it when the tag carries no readable version, because the server flag spelling differs between generations.

fields.name: lmcacheServerGeneration
fields.description: Which argparse generation RunOS renders the LMCache standalone server flags for. Applies only beside --lmcacheServerImage: with no pinned image the generation comes from the engine version, and with a pinned stock tag it is derived from the tag.

fields.name: omni
fields.description: Switches the service to the vllm-omni image variant (-omni tag) and adds --omni to serve; valid with versions 0.22.0 and 0.24.0.

fields.name: gdsEnabled
fields.description: GPUDirect Storage opt-in: stamps the cdi.k8s.io/gds annotation (nvidia.com/gds=all) on the pod so a CDI-enabled runtime injects the host /dev/nvidia-fs* devices. Requires the NVIDIA device plugin in CDI mode with a GDS CDI spec (nvidia-fs loaded); inert otherwise.

fields.name: publicHttps
fields.description: Expose the API on standard HTTPS port 443 (opt-in): the external endpoints also ride the websecure Traefik entrypoint next to the always-on 8890 one. Ingress-only, no pod roll. Consider setting an API key first (set-api-key); the deploy warns when enabled keyless.

fields.name: storageMb
fields.description: Storage size in MiB for model cache (immutable after creation)

fields.name: storageGroupId
fields.description: Which storage group backs this instance, from storage-groups/list. REQUIRED for a distributed tier (a c1/c3/c4 class), ignored by a local one. Measured 2026-08-19: without it a distributed create used to return a job id and then die at apply with "Storage group not found: undefined", because no manifest offered the field although the API accepted it. The create now refuses up front and names the groups this cluster has.

fields.name: gpuCount
fields.description: Number of GPUs to allocate (0 for CPU-only)

fields.name: nodeAffinityTags
fields.description: Node affinity tag names ("key" or "key:value"; must exist, see tags/list; tags pin scheduling to nodes carrying them).

fields.name: modelSourceIntegrationId
fields.description: Provider integration ID for S3 model source (mutually exclusive with modelSourceMinioServiceId)

fields.name: modelSourceMinioServiceId
fields.description: MinIO service ID for local model source (mutually exclusive with modelSourceIntegrationId)

fields.name: modelSourceBucket
fields.description: Bucket name containing the model (required when using S3/MinIO source)

fields.name: modelSourcePath
fields.description: Path to the model within the bucket (required when using S3/MinIO source)

fields.name: configType
fields.description: Advanced-config mode: 'custom' (edit configs directly, default) or 'config_set' (inherit from an account config set). See the config-sets topic.

fields.name: configSetId
fields.description: Config set lineage handle to adopt when configType is 'config_set'. The set's current version is pinned at creation. Must be a vllm-type set.

fields.name: lmcacheMode
fields.description: LMCache KV-cache tiering mode: 'off' (default), 'local' (in-pod engine offload to CPU/disk), or 'remote' (auto-deploy a standalone LMCache server the engine connects to). See the lmcache topic.

fields.name: lmcacheValkeyOsid
fields.description: OSID of a deployed Valkey instance to attach as the LMCache remote store (e.g. valkey-ab2cd). Optional; works in local or remote mode.

fields.name: lmcacheMinioOsid
fields.description: OSID of a deployed MinIO instance to attach as the LMCache cold/durable store (e.g. minio-ab2cd). Requires lmcacheMode=remote.

commands.description: Set vLLM advanced runtime configs (serve flags, VLLM_* env, probes, and managed files such as chat-template) on a custom-mode service. Validated against the curated vLLM config catalog. See the config-sets topic.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Service ID (5-character identifier)

fields.name: dtype
fields.description: Model weight/activation data type. `auto` picks per the model config.

fields.name: quantization
fields.description: Weight quantization method. Leave unset for unquantized weights.

fields.name: kv-cache-dtype
fields.description: KV cache data type. `auto` matches the model dtype; fp8 halves KV memory. Model-specific dtypes (e.g. fp8_ds_mla for DeepSeek/GLM MLA) are accepted. Common values: auto, fp8, fp8_e5m2, fp8_e4m3, fp8_ds_mla (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: gpu-memory-utilization
fields.description: Fraction of GPU memory to use for the model + KV cache (0–1).

fields.name: max-model-len
fields.description: Maximum context length (prompt + output) in tokens. Defaults to the model max.

fields.name: enable-prefix-caching
fields.description: Reuse KV cache across requests sharing a prefix. Prefilled on for a serving profile.

fields.name: block-size
fields.description: KV cache block size in tokens.

fields.name: cpu-offload-gb
fields.description: Per-GPU CPU memory (GiB) to offload weights to, extending effective GPU memory.

fields.name: prefix-caching-hash-algo
fields.description: Hash algorithm for prefix-cache block keys.

fields.name: tensor-parallel-size
fields.description: Number of GPUs to shard each layer across (tensor parallelism).

fields.name: decode-context-parallel-size
fields.description: Number of context-parallel ranks used for decode attention.

fields.name: pipeline-parallel-size
fields.description: Number of pipeline-parallel stages.

fields.name: data-parallel-size
fields.description: Data-parallel replica count (replaces the removed --uvicorn-workers).

fields.name: enable-expert-parallel
fields.description: Use expert parallelism instead of tensor parallelism for MoE layers.

fields.name: max-parallel-loading-workers
fields.description: Load model shards in this many parallel workers to cut startup time.

fields.name: max-num-batched-tokens
fields.description: Max tokens processed per scheduler iteration. Higher = more throughput, more memory.

fields.name: max-num-seqs
fields.description: Max concurrent sequences per iteration.

fields.name: enable-chunked-prefill
fields.description: Chunk large prefills so they batch with decodes. Prefilled on for a serving profile.

fields.name: async-scheduling
fields.description: Overlap engine-core scheduling with GPU execution to cut scheduling overhead.

fields.name: scheduling-policy
fields.description: Request scheduling policy.

fields.name: long-prefill-token-threshold
fields.description: A prefill longer than this many tokens is treated as a long request.

fields.name: max-num-partial-prefills
fields.description: Max concurrent partial prefills when chunked prefill is on.

fields.name: num-lookahead-slots
fields.description: Lookahead KV slots reserved for speculative decoding.

fields.name: attention-backend
fields.description: Attention kernel backend (replaces the removed VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND env).

fields.name: gdn-prefill-backend
fields.description: Prefill kernel backend for gated delta networks such as Qwen3.6.

fields.name: enable-prompt-embeds
fields.description: Accept pre-computed prompt embeddings via the API.

fields.name: limit-mm-per-prompt
fields.description: Per-modality input cap, JSON object e.g. {"image":2,"video":0}.

fields.name: trust-remote-code
fields.description: Allow executing custom model code from the HF repo (needed by some architectures).

fields.name: mm-processor-kwargs
fields.description: Extra kwargs passed to the multimodal processor, JSON object.

fields.name: disable-mm-preprocessor-cache
fields.description: Disable caching of processed multimodal inputs.

fields.name: enable-auto-tool-choice
fields.description: Enable automatic tool/function calling (pair with tool-call-parser).

fields.name: tool-call-parser
fields.description: Parser for model tool-call output. Model-specific. Common values: hermes, mistral, llama3_json, llama4_pythonic, pythonic, granite, jamba, qwen3_coder, deepseek_v3, deepseek_v4, internlm, phi4_mini_json, gemma4, glm45, glm47 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: reasoning-parser
fields.description: Parser that splits reasoning traces from the final answer. Model-specific. Common values: deepseek_r1, deepseek_v4, qwen3, granite, hunyuan_a13b, glm45, glm47, gemma4 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: chat-template
fields.description: Custom Jinja chat template mounted as a managed read-only file.

fields.name: chat-template-content-format
fields.description: How chat message content is rendered into the template.

fields.name: enable-auto-tool-choice-strict
fields.description: Enforce strict JSON-schema adherence for tool arguments.

fields.name: enable-lora
fields.description: Enable serving LoRA adapters on top of the base model.

fields.name: max-loras
fields.description: Max LoRA adapters resident in a single batch.

fields.name: max-lora-rank
fields.description: Maximum LoRA rank supported.

fields.name: max-cpu-loras
fields.description: Max LoRA adapters held in CPU memory (>= max-loras).

fields.name: fully-sharded-loras
fields.description: Fully shard LoRA computation across tensor-parallel ranks.

fields.name: speculative-config
fields.description: Speculative decoding config, JSON object e.g. {"method":"ngram","num_speculative_tokens":5}.

fields.name: max-logprobs
fields.description: Max logprobs returnable per token.

fields.name: logits-processor-pattern
fields.description: Regex allowing per-request custom logits processors by qualified name.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Random seed for reproducible sampling.

fields.name: generation-config
fields.description: Where to load default generation config from: 'auto', 'vllm', or a path.

fields.name: enforce-eager
fields.description: Disable CUDA graphs and run in eager mode (lower memory, lower throughput).

fields.name: compilation-config
fields.description: torch.compile / CUDA-graph config, JSON object e.g. {"level":3}.

fields.name: max-seq-len-to-capture
fields.description: Max sequence length covered by captured CUDA graphs.

fields.name: cuda-graph-sizes
fields.description: Comma-separated batch sizes to capture CUDA graphs for (e.g. 1,2,4,8).

fields.name: distributed-executor-backend
fields.description: Backend for multi-GPU/multi-node execution.

fields.name: disable-custom-all-reduce
fields.description: Disable the custom all-reduce kernel and fall back to NCCL.

fields.name: tokenizer-mode
fields.description: Tokenizer implementation. Model-specific modes are accepted. Common values: auto, slow, mistral, custom, deepseek_v4 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: load-format
fields.description: Weight load format.

fields.name: extra-serve-args
fields.description: Guarded JSON argv array for upstream serve flags not yet modeled by RunOS.

fields.name: enable-log-requests
fields.description: Log every request (replaces the removed --disable-log-requests, inverted).

fields.name: disable-log-stats
fields.description: Disable periodic throughput/latency stats logging.

fields.name: max-log-len
fields.description: Max prompt characters printed in request logs.

fields.name: otlp-traces-endpoint
fields.description: OTLP endpoint to export request traces to.

fields.name: deploy-config
fields.description: Deploy config YAML path (or bundled name, e.g. moss_tts) replacing the vllm_omni/deploy/<model_type>.yaml that --omni auto-loads; mutually exclusive with stage-configs-path. Omni services only; a non-omni image fails at engine start.

fields.name: stage-configs-path
fields.description: Legacy-model variant of deploy-config: path to a stage_args-format stage configs YAML (deprecated upstream; still mandatory for legacy models). Omni services only; a non-omni image fails at engine start.

fields.name: stage-overrides
fields.description: Per-stage engine-arg overrides, JSON object keyed by stage id, e.g. {"0":{"gpu_memory_utilization":0.8}}; for the matching stage these beat global CLI flags, which beat the deploy YAML. Omni services only; a non-omni image fails at engine start.

fields.name: stage-id
fields.description: Select and launch a single pipeline stage by stage id in this process; requires omni-master-address and omni-master-port (parse-time error otherwise). Omni services only; a non-omni image fails at engine start.

fields.name: omni-master-address
fields.description: Hostname or IP of the Omni orchestrator (master) a stage process registers with; required whenever stage-id is set. Omni services only; a non-omni image fails at engine start.

fields.name: omni-master-port
fields.description: Port of the Omni orchestrator (master); required whenever stage-id is set. Omni services only; a non-omni image fails at engine start.

fields.name: async-chunk
fields.description: Override the deploy YAML async_chunk (inter-stage streaming): true emits --async-chunk, false emits --no-async-chunk, unset leaves the YAML value in force. Omni services only; a non-omni image fails at engine start.

fields.name: VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL
fields.description: Engine log verbosity.

fields.name: VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER
fields.description: Use the FlashInfer sampling kernel. Default auto/on in 0.21.0. Common values: 1, 0 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: VLLM_FLASH_ATTN_VERSION
fields.description: Pin the FlashAttention major version.

fields.name: VLLM_USE_TRITON_FLASH_ATTN
fields.description: Use the Triton FlashAttention implementation. Common values: 1, 0 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN
fields.description: Permit a max-model-len larger than the model derives from its config. Common values: 1, 0 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING
fields.description: Run the V1 engine core in a separate process. Common values: 1, 0 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD
fields.description: Multiprocessing start method for workers.

fields.name: VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT
fields.description: Inter-process RPC timeout in milliseconds.

fields.name: VLLM_ENGINE_ITERATION_TIMEOUT_S
fields.description: Per-iteration engine timeout in seconds.

fields.name: VLLM_IMAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT
fields.description: Timeout (s) for fetching a remote image input.

fields.name: VLLM_VIDEO_FETCH_TIMEOUT
fields.description: Timeout (s) for fetching a remote video input.

fields.name: VLLM_AUDIO_FETCH_TIMEOUT
fields.description: Timeout (s) for fetching a remote audio input.

fields.name: VLLM_MM_INPUT_CACHE_GIB
fields.description: Size (GiB) of the multimodal input cache.

fields.name: VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING
fields.description: Allow loading/unloading LoRA adapters at runtime via the API. Common values: 1, 0 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: VLLM_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE
fields.description: Disable the torch.compile artifact cache. Common values: 1, 0 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: VLLM_NO_DEPRECATION_WARNING
fields.description: Suppress deprecation warnings in logs. Common values: 1, 0 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: VLLM_API_KEY_HEADER
fields.description: Custom header name the API key is read from.

fields.name: VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE
fields.description: Expose extra dev/debug endpoints. Do not enable in production. Common values: 1, 0 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: VLLM_LOG_STATS_INTERVAL
fields.description: Interval (s) between engine stats log lines.

fields.name: VLLM_TORCH_PROFILER_DIR
fields.description: Directory to write torch profiler traces to (enables profiling).

fields.name: VLLM_SKIP_WARMUP
fields.description: Skip the startup warmup pass (faster start, first requests slower). Common values: 1, 0 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: VLLM_KEEP_ALIVE_ON_ENGINE_DEATH
fields.description: Keep the HTTP server up if the engine core dies (for debugging). Common values: 1, 0 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM
fields.description: Enable DeepGEMM kernels for supported quantized matmuls. Emitted verbatim: vLLM parses this one as an integer, so use '1'/'0', not 'true'/'false'. Common values: 1, 0 (not exhaustive; other values accepted).

fields.name: extra-env
fields.description: Guarded JSON object of extra environment variables not yet modeled by RunOS.

fields.name: startup-probe-initial-delay-seconds
fields.description: Seconds after container start before the first startup probe.

fields.name: startup-probe-period-seconds
fields.description: Seconds between startup probe checks.

fields.name: startup-probe-timeout-seconds
fields.description: Seconds before a single startup probe check times out.

fields.name: startup-probe-failure-threshold
fields.description: Consecutive startup failures before the pod is failed. Startup grace ≈ this × period.

fields.name: startup-probe-success-threshold
fields.description: Consecutive startup successes required to be considered healthy.

fields.name: liveness-probe-initial-delay-seconds
fields.description: Seconds after container start before the first liveness probe.

fields.name: liveness-probe-period-seconds
fields.description: Seconds between liveness probe checks.

fields.name: liveness-probe-timeout-seconds
fields.description: Seconds before a single liveness probe check times out.

fields.name: liveness-probe-failure-threshold
fields.description: Consecutive liveness failures before the pod is restarted.

fields.name: liveness-probe-success-threshold
fields.description: Consecutive liveness successes required to be considered healthy.

fields.name: readiness-probe-initial-delay-seconds
fields.description: Seconds after container start before the first readiness probe.

fields.name: readiness-probe-period-seconds
fields.description: Seconds between readiness probe checks.

fields.name: readiness-probe-timeout-seconds
fields.description: Seconds before a single readiness probe check times out.

fields.name: readiness-probe-failure-threshold
fields.description: Consecutive readiness failures before the pod is marked not-ready.

fields.name: readiness-probe-success-threshold
fields.description: Consecutive readiness successes required to be considered healthy.

commands.description: Set, rotate, or clear the service's API key. When set, vLLM guards its /v1/* endpoints with it (clients send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`). The key is stored in a Kubernetes Secret in the service namespace; read it back via services/vllm/{id}/api-key-credentials (`show` only reports apiKeySet/apiKeyUpdatedAt). Setting, rotating, or clearing rolls the pod (the model reloads; expect a brief outage). Setting is refused on multi-replica services (the KV-aware router's backend discovery would be locked out); clearing is always allowed.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Service ID (5-character identifier)

fields.name: apiKey
fields.description: The new API key (16-512 printable ASCII characters, no spaces; use a generated high-entropy value). Send an empty string to clear the key and reopen the endpoint.

commands.description: Set the per-service LMCache engine config (the in-pod LMCache engine, delivered as LMCACHE_* env; used in local + remote mode). Validated against the lmcache-engine schema; run `service-info advanced-config-schema lmcache-engine` to see the fields. Re-applies the manifest.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Service ID (5-character identifier)

fields.name: chunk_size

fields.name: local_cpu
fields.description: Offload KV cache to pinned CPU RAM (hot tier).

fields.name: max_local_cpu_size
fields.description: Max CPU RAM for the cache, in GB.

fields.name: max_local_disk_size
fields.description: Max local-disk cache size in GB (0 = disabled).

fields.name: local_disk
fields.description: Local disk cache path (e.g. file:///cache/), empty = off.

fields.name: remote_url
fields.description: Remote store URL (e.g. redis://host:6379); RunOS sets this from the attached store.

fields.name: remote_serde
fields.description: Wire serialization for the remote store.

fields.name: cache_policy
fields.description: Eviction policy for the local cache.

fields.name: local_cpu_use_hugepages
fields.description: Back the CPU cache with hugepages.

fields.name: reserve_local_cpu_size
fields.description: CPU RAM (GB) reserved (not used for cache).

fields.name: local_disk_path_sharding
fields.description: How disk paths are sharded (e.g. by_gpu).

fields.name: store_location

fields.name: blocking_timeout_secs

fields.name: priority_limit

fields.name: min_retrieve_tokens

fields.name: hit_miss_ratio

fields.name: blend_recompute_ratios

fields.name: blend_thresholds

fields.name: blend_check_layers

fields.name: blend_min_tokens

fields.name: blend_special_str

fields.name: lmcache_instance_id

fields.name: lmcache_worker_heartbeat_delay_time

fields.name: lmcache_worker_heartbeat_time

fields.name: enable_pd

fields.name: pd_role

fields.name: pd_buffer_size

fields.name: pd_buffer_device

fields.name: pd_backend_mode

fields.name: pd_allocation_timeout_sec

fields.name: pd_condition_poll_interval_sec

fields.name: pd_max_prefill_len

fields.name: pd_skip_proxy_notification
fields.description: Skip notifying the PD proxy on transfer.

fields.name: id

fields.title: Routing Logic
fields.shortDescription: Load-balancing / routing logic across vLLM replicas.
fields.longDescription: How the router picks which vLLM replica serves a request (`--routing-logic`). `roundrobin` (default) load-balances evenly and always works; `session` pins a client/session to a replica; `kvaware` routes to the replica most likely to already hold the prompt prefix in its KV cache (the cache-aware mode, integrates with LMCache); `prefixaware` routes by prompt-prefix locality; the `disaggregated_prefill*` modes split prefill and decode across replicas.

fields.title: Max Concurrent Requests
fields.shortDescription: Max in-flight requests the router admits at once.
fields.longDescription: Upper bound on requests the router processes simultaneously. Beyond this, requests are rejected. Raise for high-throughput fleets; lower to protect backends.

fields.title: Queue Timeout
fields.shortDescription: Max seconds a request waits in the queue.
fields.longDescription: Maximum seconds a request may sit in the admission queue before it is failed. Prevents requests from waiting indefinitely during sustained overload.

fields.title: Request Timeout
fields.shortDescription: Overall per-request timeout in seconds.
fields.longDescription: Overall timeout for a single request through the router, including generation time. Set high enough for your longest legitimate completion; the default 1800s suits long generations.

fields.title: CORS Allowed Origins
fields.shortDescription: Comma-separated CORS allowed origins (empty = none).
fields.longDescription: Comma-separated list of browser origins permitted via CORS. Leave empty to disallow cross-origin browser requests; set when calling the router directly from a web app.

fields.title: Cache Threshold
fields.shortDescription: Prefix-match ratio above which a cached worker is preferred.
fields.longDescription: Minimum fraction of a prompt that must already be cached on a worker for cache_aware routing to prefer that worker over load balancing. Higher values demand a stronger prefix match before sacrificing balance.

fields.title: Balance Absolute Threshold
fields.shortDescription: Absolute load gap before rebalancing off the cached worker.
fields.longDescription: Absolute difference in in-flight requests between the cached worker and the least-loaded worker beyond which the router rebalances away from cache locality. Guards against overloading a hot cached replica.

fields.title: Balance Relative Threshold
fields.shortDescription: Relative load ratio before rebalancing off the cached worker.
fields.longDescription: Relative load ratio (cached worker vs least-loaded) above which the router prefers balance over cache locality. Works with the absolute threshold to bound cache-induced imbalance.

fields.title: Eviction Interval
fields.shortDescription: Seconds between prefix-tree eviction sweeps.
fields.longDescription: How often (seconds) the router sweeps its prefix-cache radix tree to evict stale entries, keeping the tree within max_tree_size and its view of worker caches fresh.

fields.title: Max Tree Size
fields.shortDescription: Max nodes in the prefix-cache radix tree.
fields.longDescription: Maximum number of nodes in the router’s prefix-cache radix tree. Larger tracks more prompt prefixes (better cache_aware decisions) using more router memory; the default is 2^26.

fields.title: Rate Limit (tokens/sec)
fields.shortDescription: Token-bucket rate limit (defaults to max concurrent).
fields.longDescription: Token-bucket cap on tokens admitted per second across the router. Leave unset to default to the max-concurrent setting; set to throttle aggregate token throughput.

fields.title: Max Payload Size
fields.shortDescription: Max request body size in bytes.
fields.longDescription: Largest request body (bytes) the router accepts. Raise for very large multimodal or batch payloads; the default is 512 MB.

fields.title: Disable Retries
fields.shortDescription: Turn off automatic retries of failed upstream requests.
fields.longDescription: When true, the router does not retry a request that fails against a worker. Leave false so transient worker errors are retried against another replica.

fields.title: Max Retries
fields.shortDescription: Maximum retry attempts per request.
fields.longDescription: How many times the router retries a failed request (against other workers) before giving up. Higher improves resilience to flaky workers at the cost of added latency on failures.

fields.title: Initial Retry Backoff
fields.shortDescription: Initial retry backoff in milliseconds.
fields.longDescription: Delay before the first retry, in milliseconds. Grows by the backoff multiplier on each subsequent attempt.

fields.title: Max Retry Backoff
fields.shortDescription: Maximum retry backoff in milliseconds.
fields.longDescription: Ceiling on the exponential retry backoff, in milliseconds, so retries do not wait unboundedly long.

fields.title: Retry Backoff Multiplier
fields.shortDescription: Exponential backoff growth factor between retries.
fields.longDescription: Factor the retry backoff is multiplied by after each attempt (exponential backoff). 1.5 grows delays moderately.

fields.title: Retry Jitter Factor
fields.shortDescription: Random jitter fraction added to each backoff.
fields.longDescription: Random fraction (0–1) added to each backoff to de-correlate retries across concurrent requests and avoid thundering-herd retries.

fields.title: Disable Circuit Breaker
fields.shortDescription: Turn off the per-worker circuit breaker.
fields.longDescription: When true, the router keeps sending to a worker even after repeated failures. Leave false so a failing replica is temporarily removed from rotation.

fields.title: Failure Threshold
fields.shortDescription: Failures before a worker circuit opens.
fields.longDescription: Number of failures within the window before a worker’s circuit opens (the router stops sending to it). Lower trips faster on bad workers.

fields.title: Success Threshold
fields.shortDescription: Successes in half-open before the circuit closes.
fields.longDescription: Consecutive successes required while half-open before a worker’s circuit fully closes and it returns to normal rotation.

fields.title: Circuit Open Duration
fields.shortDescription: Seconds a circuit stays open before half-opening.
fields.longDescription: How long (seconds) a circuit stays fully open before the router probes the worker again (half-open).

fields.title: Failure Window
fields.shortDescription: Sliding window (s) over which failures are counted.
fields.longDescription: Sliding time window (seconds) over which failures are counted toward the failure threshold.

fields.title: Log Level
fields.shortDescription: Router log verbosity.
fields.longDescription: Verbosity of the router’s own logs. `debug`/`trace` help diagnose routing decisions; `info` is the production default.

fields.title: Request ID Headers
fields.shortDescription: Comma-separated headers to read a request id from.
fields.longDescription: Comma-separated header names the router reads a request/correlation id from for logging and tracing. Defaults to the common x-request-id family.

fields.title: Router CPU Request
fields.shortDescription: CPU the router pod reserves, in millicores.
fields.longDescription: CPU the router container reserves, in millicores. Without a request the router pod is BestEffort, which makes it the first pod the kubelet evicts under node pressure, and the router is the front door of a multi-replica service. RunOS requests 200m, which makes the pod Burstable. No limit is rendered: a limit on the front door turns a traffic spike into throttling.

fields.title: Router Memory Request
fields.shortDescription: Memory the router pod reserves, in mebibytes.
fields.longDescription: Memory the router container reserves, in mebibytes. RunOS requests 512Mi. Raise it for a large fleet, where the router holds more per-worker routing state. No limit is rendered, for the same reason as the CPU request.

fields.title: Router Environment Variables
fields.shortDescription: Guarded JSON object of environment variables for the router container.
fields.longDescription: Environment variables set on the router container, as a JSON object such as {"HF_HUB_OFFLINE":"1"}. Values are passed to the container verbatim, so spell them exactly as the variable expects ("1" and "true" are not interchangeable). RunOS renders its own entries BEFORE this map, and Kubernetes takes the last variable of a repeated name, so a value set here overrides a RunOS default of the same name. Secret-bearing names are refused, because this map is stored in plain text: use a dedicated secret surface for a token.

fields.title: Startup Probe: Initial Delay (s)
fields.shortDescription: Seconds after the router container starts before its first startup probe.
fields.longDescription: Seconds the kubelet waits after the router container starts before it runs the first startup probe. The startup probe gates the liveness and the readiness probe: the kubelet runs neither until the startup probe first succeeds.

fields.title: Startup Probe: Period (s)
fields.shortDescription: Seconds between startup probe checks on the router.
fields.longDescription: Seconds between startup probe checks on the router. The RunOS default for this probe is 24 failures at 5 second intervals, which is 120 seconds.

fields.title: Startup Probe: Timeout (s)
fields.shortDescription: Seconds one startup probe check may take before it counts as a failure.
fields.longDescription: Seconds the kubelet waits for one startup HTTP check against the router before it counts the check as a failure. The Kubernetes default is 1 second, which counts a single slow answer as a failure; RunOS sets 3.

fields.title: Startup Probe: Failure Threshold
fields.shortDescription: Consecutive startup failures before the router pod is failed.
fields.longDescription: Consecutive startup failures the kubelet tolerates before it fails the router pod. The startup grace is about failureThreshold multiplied by periodSeconds. The RunOS default for this probe is 24 failures at 5 second intervals, which is 120 seconds. The startup probe gates the liveness and the readiness probe: the kubelet runs neither until the startup probe first succeeds.

fields.title: Startup Probe: Success Threshold
fields.shortDescription: Consecutive startup successes before the router pod counts as healthy.
fields.longDescription: Consecutive successful startup checks before the router counts as healthy. Kubernetes requires 1 for the startup probe, so 1 is the only accepted value.

fields.title: Liveness Probe: Initial Delay (s)
fields.shortDescription: Seconds after the router container starts before its first liveness probe.
fields.longDescription: Seconds the kubelet waits after the router container starts before it runs the first liveness probe. The startup probe gates the liveness and the readiness probe: the kubelet runs neither until the startup probe first succeeds.

fields.title: Liveness Probe: Period (s)
fields.shortDescription: Seconds between liveness probe checks on the router.
fields.longDescription: Seconds between liveness probe checks on the router. The RunOS default for this probe is 6 failures at 10 second intervals, which is 60 seconds.

fields.title: Liveness Probe: Timeout (s)
fields.shortDescription: Seconds one liveness probe check may take before it counts as a failure.
fields.longDescription: Seconds the kubelet waits for one liveness HTTP check against the router before it counts the check as a failure. The Kubernetes default is 1 second, which counts a single slow answer as a failure; RunOS sets 5.

fields.title: Liveness Probe: Failure Threshold
fields.shortDescription: Consecutive liveness failures before the router pod is restarted.
fields.longDescription: Consecutive liveness failures before the router pod is restarted. The RunOS default for this probe is 6 failures at 10 second intervals, which is 60 seconds.

fields.title: Liveness Probe: Success Threshold
fields.shortDescription: Consecutive liveness successes before the router pod counts as healthy.
fields.longDescription: Consecutive successful liveness checks before the router counts as healthy. Kubernetes requires 1 for the liveness probe, so 1 is the only accepted value.

fields.title: Readiness Probe: Initial Delay (s)
fields.shortDescription: Seconds after the router container starts before its first readiness probe.
fields.longDescription: Seconds the kubelet waits after the router container starts before it runs the first readiness probe. The startup probe gates the liveness and the readiness probe: the kubelet runs neither until the startup probe first succeeds.

fields.title: Readiness Probe: Period (s)
fields.shortDescription: Seconds between readiness probe checks on the router.
fields.longDescription: Seconds between readiness probe checks on the router. The RunOS default for this probe is 3 failures at 5 second intervals, which is 15 seconds.

fields.title: Readiness Probe: Timeout (s)
fields.shortDescription: Seconds one readiness probe check may take before it counts as a failure.
fields.longDescription: Seconds the kubelet waits for one readiness HTTP check against the router before it counts the check as a failure. The Kubernetes default is 1 second, which counts a single slow answer as a failure; RunOS sets 3.

fields.title: Readiness Probe: Failure Threshold
fields.shortDescription: Consecutive readiness failures before the router pod is left out of the Service.
fields.longDescription: Consecutive readiness failures before the router pod is taken out of the Service. The RunOS default for this probe is 3 failures at 5 second intervals, which is 15 seconds.

fields.title: Readiness Probe: Success Threshold
fields.shortDescription: Consecutive readiness successes before the router pod counts as healthy.
fields.longDescription: Consecutive successful readiness checks before the router pod returns to the Service. Default 1.

fields.title: Chunk Size
fields.shortDescription: KV chunk size in tokens (must match the engine).
fields.longDescription: KV chunk size in tokens for the server. Must match the engine chunk_size so chunks line up; mismatched sizes prevent reuse. Default 256.

fields.title: L1 Cache Size (GB)
fields.shortDescription: Server in-memory (L1) cache size in GB.
fields.longDescription: Size of the server in-memory (L1) cache, in gigabytes. L1 is the hot tier in front of the L2 backend (Valkey/MinIO); size it against the server pod memory.

fields.title: Eviction Policy
fields.shortDescription: L1 eviction policy.
fields.longDescription: How the server evicts from L1 when full. LRU is the default; IsolatedLRU partitions the LRU set; noop disables eviction (L1 must not overflow).

fields.title: Max Workers
fields.shortDescription: Worker processes the server runs.
fields.longDescription: Number of worker processes the server runs to handle transfers. Higher increases throughput and memory use; defaults to 1.

fields.title: Engine Type
fields.shortDescription: Server engine type.
fields.longDescription: Server engine type.

fields.title: Hash Algorithm
fields.shortDescription: Chunk hashing algorithm.
fields.longDescription: Chunk hashing algorithm.

fields.title: Transfer Mode
fields.shortDescription: Supported KV transfer mode. 0.25.x engines: auto/lmcache_driven/engine_driven; older engines (0.4.6 server): gpu/non_gpu.
fields.longDescription: Supported KV transfer mode. 0.25.x engines: auto/lmcache_driven/engine_driven; older engines (0.4.6 server): gpu/non_gpu.

fields.title: L1 Use Lazy
fields.shortDescription: Allocate the L1 buffer lazily (upstream default: on).
fields.longDescription: Allocate the L1 buffer lazily (upstream default: on).

fields.title: L1 Init Size Gb
fields.shortDescription: Initial L1 allocation in GB (lazy mode).
fields.longDescription: Initial L1 allocation in GB (lazy mode).

fields.title: L1 Align Bytes
fields.shortDescription: L1 allocation alignment in bytes.
fields.longDescription: L1 allocation alignment in bytes.

fields.title: L1 Write Ttl Seconds
fields.shortDescription: TTL for written L1 entries, in seconds.
fields.longDescription: TTL for written L1 entries, in seconds.

fields.title: L1 Read Ttl Seconds
fields.shortDescription: TTL refresh on read for L1 entries, in seconds.
fields.longDescription: TTL refresh on read for L1 entries, in seconds.

fields.title: Eviction Trigger Watermark
fields.shortDescription: Fill ratio that triggers eviction.
fields.longDescription: Fill ratio that triggers eviction.

fields.title: Eviction Ratio
fields.shortDescription: Fraction of L1 evicted per sweep.
fields.longDescription: Fraction of L1 evicted per sweep.

fields.title: L2 Store Policy
fields.shortDescription: L2 write/store policy (built-in: default; plugins may register more).
fields.longDescription: L2 write/store policy (built-in: default; plugins may register more).

fields.title: L2 Prefetch Policy
fields.shortDescription: L2 prefetch policy (built-in: default, retain; plugins may register more).
fields.longDescription: L2 prefetch policy (built-in: default, retain; plugins may register more).

fields.title: L2 Prefetch Max In Flight
fields.shortDescription: Max concurrent L2 prefetch operations.
fields.longDescription: Max concurrent L2 prefetch operations.

fields.title: L2 Adapters (JSON)
fields.shortDescription: Raw L2 adapter JSON escape hatch (RunOS renders this from the attached store).
fields.longDescription: Raw L2 storage-adapter JSON. Normally RunOS renders this for you from the Valkey/MinIO store you attach (resp / s3 adapters). Set it directly only as an escape hatch for exotic backends (e.g. mooncake_store, nixl_store) that are out of v1 scope.

fields.title: Max Gpu Workers
fields.shortDescription: Max GPU workers (defaults to max_workers).
fields.longDescription: Max GPU workers (defaults to max_workers).

fields.title: Max Cpu Workers
fields.shortDescription: Max CPU workers (defaults to max_workers).
fields.longDescription: Max CPU workers (defaults to max_workers).

fields.title: Runtime Plugin Locations
fields.shortDescription: Runtime plugin locations (comma-separated; each becomes its own argument).
fields.longDescription: Runtime plugin locations (comma-separated; each becomes its own argument).

fields.title: Runtime Plugin Config
fields.shortDescription: JSON config passed to runtime plugins.
fields.longDescription: JSON config passed to runtime plugins.

fields.title: Lookup Hash Log Dir
fields.shortDescription: Directory for lookup-hash logs (empty = off).
fields.longDescription: Directory for lookup-hash logs (empty = off).

fields.title: Lookup Hash Log Rotation Interval
fields.shortDescription: Lookup-hash log rotation interval in seconds.
fields.longDescription: Lookup-hash log rotation interval in seconds.

fields.title: Lookup Hash Log Rotation Max Size
fields.shortDescription: Max lookup-hash log size before rotation, in bytes.
fields.longDescription: Max lookup-hash log size before rotation, in bytes.

fields.title: Lookup Hash Log Max Files
fields.shortDescription: Max retained lookup-hash log files.
fields.longDescription: Max retained lookup-hash log files.

fields.title: Disable Observability
fields.shortDescription: Disable all server observability.
fields.longDescription: Disable all server observability.

fields.title: Disable Metrics
fields.shortDescription: Disable metrics emission.
fields.longDescription: Disable metrics emission.

fields.title: Disable Logging
fields.shortDescription: Disable server logging.
fields.longDescription: Disable server logging.

fields.title: Enable Tracing
fields.shortDescription: Enable distributed tracing.
fields.longDescription: Enable distributed tracing.

fields.title: Event Bus Queue Size
fields.shortDescription: Event-bus queue size.
fields.longDescription: Event-bus queue size.

fields.title: Otlp Endpoint
fields.shortDescription: OTLP collector endpoint (sink wiring deferred in v1).
fields.longDescription: OTLP collector endpoint (sink wiring deferred in v1).

fields.title: Prometheus Port
fields.shortDescription: Prometheus scrape port (scrape wiring deferred in v1).
fields.longDescription: Prometheus scrape port (scrape wiring deferred in v1).

fields.title: Service Instance Id
fields.shortDescription: Stable service-instance id for telemetry.
fields.longDescription: Stable service-instance id for telemetry.
